articles.summary: Some members of this year’s freshman class won’t make it to graduation. Colleges have spent decades reckoning with this reality, and research continues to point to the same key factor in improving retention outcomes: student engagement in higher education. Every institution wants similar things for its students: for them to enroll, stay the course of A practical guide to student engagement in higher education: what it actually means, why it matters for retention, and five strategies colleges are using.
articles.title: Student Engagement in Higher Education: The Ultimate Guide
